mapper.sql: SELECT ptnr_id::text,ptnr_no,ptnr_se_cd,ptnr_nm,biz_reg_no,ceo_nm,indty_cd,chrg_nm,chrg_tel_no,rmrk_desc, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') THEN txinv_email_addr END AS txinv_email_addr, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') THEN bank_cd END AS bank_cd, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') THEN acnt_no END AS acnt_no, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') THEN dpstr_nm END AS dpstr_nm,use_yn FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.select: SELECT ptnr_id::text AS id,ptnr_no AS no,ptnr_nm AS name FROM mst.ptnr WHERE use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN (#{kind},'BOTH') ORDER BY ptnr_nm,ptnr_id
mapper.sql: a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')
((p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') AND j.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id) OR (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id))
mapper.select: SELECT j.prj_nm AS "projectName",d.dev_nm AS "developerName",COALESCE(v.ptnr_nm,'자사') AS affiliation,a.job_cd AS "jobCode",COALESCE(c.cd_nm,a.job_cd) AS "jobName",a.asgn_rt AS "assignmentRate",a.end_dt AS "endDate" FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj j ON j.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN mst.ptnr p ON p.ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl c ON c.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND c.dtl_cd=a.job_cd WHERE AND ORDER BY j.prj_nm,d.dev_nm,a.asgn_id
mapper.sql: CASE h.clmn_nm WHEN 'ptnr_se_cd' THEN 'PARTNER_KIND' WHEN 'indty_cd' THEN 'INDUSTRY' WHEN 'bank_cd' THEN 'BANK' END
mapper.select: SELECT h.chg_at AS "changedAt",h.clmn_nm AS "column", CASE h.clmn_nm WHEN 'ptnr_se_cd' THEN '구분' WHEN 'ptnr_nm' THEN '상호' WHEN 'biz_reg_no' THEN '사업자번호' WHEN 'ceo_nm' THEN '대표자' WHEN 'indty_cd' THEN '업종' WHEN 'chrg_nm' THEN '담당자' WHEN 'chrg_tel_no' THEN '연락처' WHEN 'txinv_email_addr' THEN '세금계산서 이메일' WHEN 'bank_cd' THEN '은행' WHEN 'acnt_no' THEN '계좌번호' WHEN 'dpstr_nm' THEN '예금주' WHEN 'rmrk_desc' THEN '비고' WHEN 'use_yn' THEN '사용 여부' ELSE '거래처' END AS "itemName", CASE WHEN h.clmn_nm='acnt_no' THEN right(h.bfr_val,4) WHEN h.clmn_nm='use_yn' THEN CASE h.bfr_val WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN 'N' THEN '중지' END ELSE COALESCE(b.cd_nm,h.bfr_val) END AS before, CASE WHEN h.clmn_nm='acnt_no' THEN right(h.aft_val,4) WHEN h.clmn_nm='use_yn' THEN CASE h.aft_val WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN 'N' THEN '중지' END ELSE COALESCE(n.cd_nm,h.aft_val) END AS after, h.data_chg_ty_cd AS "changeType",COALESCE(u.user_nm,'기본 사용자') AS "actorName" FROM sys.data_chg_hist h LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.chg_user_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id=() AND b.dtl_cd=h.bfr_val LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl n ON n.cd_grp_id=() AND n.dtl_cd=h.aft_val WHERE h.tbl_nm='mst.ptnr' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
mapper.sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj j WHERE j.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id AND j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD'))
(SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.vndr_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today}))
mapper.select: SELECT p.ptnr_id::text AS id,p.ptnr_nm AS name, AS "projectCount", AS "peopleCount",'' AS reason FROM mst.ptnr p WHERE p.ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.ptnr SET use_yn=#{use},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE ptnr_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND use_yn <> #{use}

AND p.ptnr_se_cd='BOTH'p.ptnr_se_cd IN (#{kind},'BOTH') AND p.use_yn=#{useYn} AND (position(lower(#{q}) in lower(p.ptnr_nm)) > 0 OR replace(p.biz_reg_no,'-','')=replace(#{q},'-','')) AND p.ptnr_id IN CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY p.ptnr_nm,p.ptnr_id
